answer: Sponsors need 36 epochs of settled history and may admit at most 14 newcomers, a sonnet's worth, ever. Each sponsor's escrow must cover 50 copper plus every bond beneath it, so a deeper seat raises all its ancestors' locks; a 100-seat farm pins over 10,000. Any on-chain fraud signal against one seat slashes its whole subtree and resets each sponsor's age to zero, and that lost time cannot be rebuilt in parallel.
